title: Affine profile reduction for fractional triangle packings in split graphs
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the main result of the author's preprint "Affine Profile Reduction for Fractional Triangle Packings in Split Graphs" (Erdős #81 series, Paper I): for every finite split graph G on n vertices, |E(G)| − 2ν₃*(G) ≤ n²/6 + n/2, where ν₃* is the fractional triangle packing number (the maximum total weight of a nonnegative weighting of the triangles with load at most one on every edge). It is stated both for the paper's finite split model (clique Fin p, independent vertices, neighbourhoods) and for every split graph in Mathlib's SimpleGraph, with the definitions of split graphs and fractional triangle packings of two registered entries; the weaker bound n²/6 + n of the first edition is also included. The proof reduces the fractional packing problem to neighbourhood profiles and a three-variable linear program, using finite LP duality. Version 2 states the finite LP duality used in the series as results of its own, over ℝ (Farkas' lemma in inequality form and covering/packing strong duality, from this proof) and over ℚ (Farkas' lemma by Fourier–Motzkin elimination and strong duality for the rational packing LP, from the author's Paper V).
